purpose: Verify Faculty, Dept_Admin, and HOD are permitted to create and publish announcements
expected_result: Announcement is created and published successfully

purpose: Verify Student or unauthenticated user is prohibited from publishing announcements
action_or_input: Attempt to create or publish announcement
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError or AuthenticationError raised

purpose: Verify viewer matching target role, program, and academic year can view announcement
action_or_input: Query announcements as Student in CSE 2026
expected_result: Announcement is visible in results

purpose: Verify viewer not matching target role, program, or academic year cannot view announcement
action_or_input: Query announcements as Student in CSE 2026
expected_result: Announcement is excluded from results

purpose: Verify HOD is permitted to edit active department announcement
preconditions: Active announcement exists; actor is HOD
expected_result: Announcement content updated successfully

purpose: Verify HOD is permitted to hide active department announcement
preconditions: Active announcement exists; actor is HOD
expected_result: Announcement is_hidden set to True

purpose: Verify HOD is permitted to delete active department announcement
preconditions: Active announcement exists; actor is HOD
expected_result: Announcement deleted_at timestamp set

purpose: Verify non-HOD actor is prohibited from editing, hiding, or deleting active announcement
preconditions: Active announcement exists; actor is Dept_Admin or Faculty
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError is raised

purpose: Verify Faculty is permitted to submit stock requests
preconditions: Actor is Faculty; inventory item exists with stock
expected_result: Stock request created with status Pending HOD Approval

purpose: Verify non-Faculty is prohibited from submitting stock requests
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError is raised

purpose: Verify HOD is permitted to approve stock request
expected_result: Status transitions to Approved for Issuance

purpose: Verify HOD is permitted to reject stock request
expected_result: Status transitions to Rejected

purpose: Verify non-HOD is prohibited from making stock request approval decisions
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError is raised

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin is permitted to issue stock for HOD-approved request
preconditions: StockRequest is in Approved for Issuance status; actor is Dept_Admin
expected_result: Status transitions to Issued

purpose: Verify stock issuance is prohibited for requests not approved by HOD
expected_result: Issuance blocked with validation or conflict error

purpose: Verify non-Dept_Admin is prohibited from issuing stock
preconditions: Approved StockRequest; actor is Faculty or HOD
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError is raised

purpose: Verify authenticated Students and Faculty are permitted to submit confidential feedback
preconditions: Actor is authenticated Student or Faculty
expected_result: Feedback record created with confidentiality preserved

purpose: Verify feedback is confidential and inaccessible outside authorized feedback roles
action_or_input: Unrelated user attempts to inspect feedback
expected_result: Access denied / feedback excluded from listing

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin is permitted to mark feedback Resolved or Closed after initial review
preconditions: Feedback in Under Review status; actor is Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Dept_Admin marks feedback Resolved or Closed
expected_result: Feedback transitions to terminal Resolved/Closed status

purpose: Verify HOD is permitted to mark feedback Resolved or Closed after initial review
preconditions: Feedback in Under Review status; actor is HOD
action_or_input: HOD marks feedback Resolved or Closed
expected_result: Feedback transitions to terminal Resolved/Closed status

purpose: Verify feedback in terminal status cannot be reopened or transitioned again
action_or_input: Attempt further state change on closed feedback
expected_result: Operation blocked; terminal state is final

purpose: Verify official department-detail changes require HOD approval before becoming effective
expected_result: Change held in Pending HOD Approval state; official data not updated yet

purpose: Verify Headship identity is excluded from official department detail change path
expected_result: Blocked; Headship is derived only from central HOD role assignment

purpose: Verify HOD approval makes proposed official department details effective
preconditions: Pending official change; actor is HOD
expected_result: Official department details updated with new values

purpose: Verify HOD rejection retains current official department details unchanged
preconditions: Pending official change; actor is HOD
expected_result: Change rejected; previous official details remain in effect

purpose: Verify non-HOD is prohibited from approving official department changes
preconditions: Pending official change; actor is Dept_Admin
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError is raised

purpose: Verify requested quantity > 0 and <= current inventory passes validation
expected_result: Validation passes and request enters Pending status

purpose: Verify requested quantity > current inventory is prohibited and blocked before approval
expected_result: Validation error raised and request rejected

purpose: Verify requested quantity <= 0 is prohibited
expected_result: ValidationError raised for non-positive quantity

purpose: Verify stock issuance automatically decrements current inventory quantity
expected_result: InventoryItem quantity decremented to 14

purpose: Verify stock issuance records immutable movement log with before/after counts
expected_result: StockMovement created with quantity_before=20, quantity=6, quantity_after=14

purpose: Verify stock movement log records are immutable and cannot be updated or deleted
action_or_input: Attempt to update quantity or delete movement record
expected_result: ValidationError raised on save/delete

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin initial review is required before HOD oversight access
expected_result: Feedback transitions to Under Review, enabling HOD oversight

purpose: Verify HOD oversight is prohibited prior to Dept_Admin initial review
action_or_input: HOD attempts oversight/resolution on unreviewed feedback
expected_result: Action prohibited; initial review precondition not met

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin categorizes feedback during initial review
preconditions: Feedback under review; actor is Dept_Admin
expected_result: Category saved on feedback record

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin is permitted to close simple issues directly during initial review
preconditions: Simple feedback issue under review; actor is Dept_Admin
expected_result: Status transitions to Closed

purpose: Verify central Institute Admin is permitted to assign HOD and Dept_Admin roles
expected_result: Role assignment successfully recorded

purpose: Verify department actors are prohibited from self-assigning HOD or Dept_Admin roles
action_or_input: Attempt to assign HOD or Dept_Admin role
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError is raised

purpose: Verify department enforces exactly one active HOD role assignment
action_or_input: Attempt concurrent second active HOD assignment without transfer
expected_result: System rejects second active assignment with uniqueness violation

purpose: Verify department enforces exactly one active Dept_Admin role assignment
action_or_input: Attempt concurrent second active Dept_Admin assignment without transfer
expected_result: System rejects second active assignment with uniqueness violation

purpose: Verify department role assignments must specify a valid time-bounded tenure
action_or_input: Provide start_date and end_date where start_date < end_date
expected_result: Validity period recorded and enforced

purpose: Verify displayed department Headship is derived directly from active HOD role assignment
preconditions: Active HOD assignment is held by Employee X
expected_result: Displayed Headship equals Employee X; independent HOD self-approval excluded
